{{Quote|Victorious we were at Christophsis, but defeated we have been at Selonia, Carida, and Garos Four. Another victory we do require.|Jedi Grand Master Yoda|<ref name="WS" />}}
A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garos IV]]<ref name="WS" /> in the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]]<ref name="WS" /><ref name="ERC" /> of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was victorious over the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the fight. The loss of Garos IV, together with other defeats, led [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to believe that the Republic would need another victory.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was mentioned in the [[2008]] novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', written by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="WS" />
